name: BinomialLLC/basis_universal
description: Basis Universal is a supercompressed GPU texture codec that transcodes to virtually any GPU texture format at runtime, supporting ETC1S, UASTC, ASTC, BC7, and more. The de-facto standard for portable GPU texture distribution.
score_rationale: Dominant portable GPU texture compression standard with 3k stars, used in major game engines (Unity, Godot, Babylon.js), and backed by the KTX2 spec from Khronos.
summary: Supercompressed GPU texture codec for portable cross-platform distribution
